baseline_models.focus_anchor: The distributive construction لِكُلِّ ... مِنْهُمْ assigns a singular شَأْنٌ to every individual, while يُغْنِيهِ makes that affair act upon its possessor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality is distributed person by person; each singular affair then suffices, avails, or occupies its bearer so completely that no unused capacity remains. The verse is not merely a crowd whose members happen to be busy, but an exhaustive partition into private cases.

activation_trace.role: The totality-and-completeness branch supplies exhaustive coverage and makes the distribution admit no exception.
The personal-human branch fixes the unit of distribution as an individual person rather than an undifferentiated crowd.
The affair, state, or weighty-matter branch gives each person a singular case with enough gravity to organize the reading.
The sufficing, availing, and standing-in branch makes the affair consume the person's available concern and exclude substitution by another.

changed_reading.before: Everyone will be busy with something.
changed_reading.after: Every individual is exhaustively enclosed in a singular personal case whose sufficing force leaves no surplus attention or agency for anyone else.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root inventory lets كُلِّ carry a secondary burden/dependency resonance while يُغْنِيهِ carries self-sufficiency, creating tension inside the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: A person normally bears dependents and is borne within relations, but the personal affair forces a temporary, severe independence. The verse can therefore describe not abundance but the collapse of reciprocal carrying: one's own burden is enough, and one can neither support nor be supported by another.

activation_trace.role: The dependent-as-burden branch introduces the social load ordinarily carried by or for a person.
The cultivated human-virtue branch keeps the person relational and morally answerable rather than reducing him to an isolated body.
The weighty-affair branch supplies the load that displaces all competing claims.
The self-sufficiency branch supplies forced independence, functioning here as isolation rather than prosperous autonomy.

changed_reading.before: Each person simply has an individual concern.
changed_reading.after: Each normally interdependent person is forced into a closed economy of one: the personal burden is enough to cancel both giving and receiving support.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins the encompassing potential of كُلِّ, the purposive potential of شَأْنٌ, and the dwelling potential within يُغْنِيهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The affair has directional pull and also acts like a station: it draws each person into a distinct orbit, surrounds him, and keeps him there. This spatializes engrossment without replacing the ordinary sufficiency syntax.

activation_trace.role: The encircling-ring branch gives the distributive totalizer a secondary image of a boundary closing around each person.
The person branch supplies the bounded occupant of each separate orbit.
The aiming-and-seeking branch gives the affair a directional pull that fixes attention on one end.
The settled-dwelling branch spatializes sufficiency as being made to stay within one's assigned station.

changed_reading.after: A purposive personal affair draws a boundary around each person and lodges him within its own station.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening attention scene first treats self-sufficiency as a claimant's posture, contrasts it with purposeful seeking, and depicts attention being directed to one person and diverted from another. When the same غ ن ي root returns in the focus, sufficiency reverses from a socially attractive status into a universal attention-capture mechanism: each affair now diverts its bearer from everyone else.

activation_trace.role: The weighty personal matter is the object that captures and redirects attention.
Sufficing and availing become total occupation, so the affair leaves no attention available elsewhere.
The earlier self-sufficiency branch supplies the posture whose social advantage is later reversed into isolation.
Directing oneself toward something models selective attention before the focus universalizes its capture.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end supplies the counter-image of a person actively oriented to what matters.
Being occupied by one thing away from another gives the clearest functional analogue for how the focus affair engrosses its bearer.

structural_cues: 80:5-10 arranges two claimants through opposed allocations of attention.
The recurrence of غ ن ي at 80:5 and 80:37 permits a reversal rather than a merely repeated wealth theme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed self-sufficiency, selective direction, purposeful seeking, and diversion; I infer that the focus affair hardens those attention dynamics into universal incapacity to attend outward. A live alternative is that يُغْنِيهِ denotes only sufficiency, with the attention parallel remaining secondary.

changed_reading.before: The affair privately suffices or preoccupies each person.
changed_reading.after: The earlier elective preference for a supposedly self-sufficient person becomes an unavoidable condition in which every person's own case captures attention and turns him away from all others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder-to-sheets sequence supplies a documentary apparatus: a claim-bearing reminder, written surfaces, skilled hands, and writing that discloses what it carries. Against that apparatus, each شَأْنٌ can be heard as an individual case made present by a record, while the availing/standing-in range of يُغْنِيهِ lets that case speak or stand for its person.

activation_trace.role: The affair-or-weighty-case branch supplies the individualized content capable of being documented.
The standing-in and availing branch lets the disclosed case function representatively for its bearer.
The right-document branch turns reminder into a possible claim-bearing instrument rather than memory alone.
The written-sheet branch supplies the physical record surface for the case model.
The skilled-making hand branch supplies deliberate production and custody of the record.
The book-that-reveals-writing branch makes inscription a disclosure mechanism that can expose an individual affair.

structural_cues: 80:11-16 moves from reminder to honored sheets, then to hands and scribal agents.
The focus distributes one singular affair to each person, a form compatible with individualized case records.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies documentary branches and a singular affair per person; I infer that the record architecture can extend into the focus as an individualized disclosed case. The live alternative is that the sheets concern only the reminder itself and do not imply personal dossiers.

changed_reading.before: Each person is absorbed by a private concern.
changed_reading.after: Each person confronts an individualized case whose disclosed content is sufficient to represent him, as though his affair itself stands forward as the operative record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation and an eased path culminate in the declaration that the commanded thing has not been completed. This changes شَأْنٌ from an unspecified worry into an outstanding personal commission: a measured work or obligation that each must finish or answer for, and that no other person can discharge in his place.

activation_trace.role: The doing-one's-work-well branch makes the affair performative: it is work to be carried through, not merely a mental state.
The availing and replacing branch sharpens the nondelegable question of what can complete or stand in for the person's work.
The planned estimation of an affair supplies a designed measure within which the personal commission operates.
Completion and bringing-to-an-end supply the explicit missing endpoint that turns the focus affair into unfinished business.
The command root's own affair-or-state branch directly bridges the commanded object to the focus شَأْنٌ.
The request-and-obligation branch supplies binding force, making the affair an assignment rather than an accidental concern.

structural_cues: 80:18-23 runs from origin through measure, path, death, and revival to an explicitly uncompleted command.
The singular شَأْنٌ after لِكُلِّ makes the unfinished commission distributively personal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, noncompletion, obligation, and a direct affair-branch bridge; I infer that each focus affair is the person's outstanding commission exposed at the event. A live alternative is that the affair is the consequence or accounting of failed work, not the work itself.

changed_reading.before: Each person has enough trouble to remain occupied.
changed_reading.after: Each person faces a measured but unfinished commission that is wholly his to answer for and cannot be completed by another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The food sequence traces provision from poured water through production to useful sustenance. It activates the otherwise remote food, feeding, and esophagus branches inside the focus root for person. The resulting person is an embodied receiver whose sufficiency has traveled through a material chain; يُغْنِيهِ can no longer sound like intrinsic autonomy, but like a capacity filled from outside and then monopolized by one affair.

activation_trace.role: The agreeable-food branch makes the named person resonate as an eater whose received nourishment suits and sustains him.
The esophageal-passage branch supplies the narrow bodily channel through which the broad provision sequence becomes personal.
The self-sufficiency branch becomes the proposition tested and destabilized by the person's visible material dependence.
The livelihood-and-provision branch frames food as maintained life rather than an isolated edible object.
The pouring-flow branch supplies the first directional movement in the external-to-internal provision chain.
The conveying-water-by-pouring branch turns water into delivered support and makes dependence mechanically explicit.
The useful provision for needs branch closes the chain at creaturely requirement and attainment.

structural_cues: 80:24 commands the human to inspect his own food, then 80:25-32 unfolds the production chain behind it.
The chain terminates in provision for humans and their cattle, preventing an uncomplicated autonomous reading of sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered provision chain and food/anatomy branches within م ر ء; I infer an external-to-internal pipeline that exposes the focus person's received sufficiency. The live alternative is that the food sequence demonstrates provision without activating the anatomically remote branches of the person root.

changed_reading.before: An autonomous individual is made self-sufficient by his own concern.
changed_reading.after: Each embodied eater, sustained through an immense received chain, reaches a moment when one personal affair fills his remaining capacity; the sufficiency is dependent and isolating, not self-created wealth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest bonds are successively presented as flight-paths: tethered siblinghood, parental origin and nurture, constant companionship, and filiation. Their normal functions are support, gathering, and continuity, yet the focus redistributes the scene into one affair per person. The affair therefore behaves as a counterclaim that exhausts relational capacity and converts bonds into liabilities from which each flees.

activation_trace.role: The dependent-burden branch makes family claims concrete loads whose carrying capacity can fail.
The weighty personal affair supplies the counterclaim that outranks every relational demand.
Sufficing and replacing explain why the one affair displaces all other claims and leaves no helper able to stand in.
The escape branch supplies the enacted rupture by which relational overload becomes visible.
The tether-and-binding branch makes flight from a brother the breaking of a tie, not simple physical distance.
The origin, gathering-point, and return branch makes separation from the mother a reversal of return and collection.
The fatherhood-and-nurture branch supplies a support relation that the personal affair renders unusable.
Constant companionship supplies maximal habitual nearness, sharpening the severity of its collapse.
Filiation and derivation from an origin supply continuity across generations that is interrupted by individual accounting.

structural_cues: The branchless ص خ خ occurrence at 80:33 is used only as the abrupt sequence marker before flight; no branch identity is assigned to it.
80:34-36 enumerates relations before 80:37 changes the grammatical unit from bonds to every single person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape plus branches of tether, origin, nurture, companionship, and descent; I infer that the affair acts as a capacity-exhausting counterclaim that reverses those bonds. A live alternative is that undifferentiated terror causes flight and the affair merely explains private fear, not relational liability.

changed_reading.before: Each person is too busy to help relatives.
changed_reading.after: Each personal case consumes the capacity by which kin normally carry one another, turning the closest support network into a set of claims from which the person must flee.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the private affairs, faces become uncovered surfaces with opposed outputs: opening brightness and joy, or deposited dust under an overpowering constriction. The personal affair is therefore not sealed forever inside; it is a latent state that reaches sufficiency and then renders itself visibly on the bearer.

activation_trace.role: The affair-or-state branch supplies the interior condition whose outward result the following faces display.
The sufficing branch marks the condition as complete enough to determine and expose an outcome.
The face-and-front branch supplies the public receiving surface on which the private case becomes legible.
Removing a covering supplies the transition from latent interior state to exposed appearance.
Fullness that overflows into appearance models an inward condition becoming visibly excessive.
Completion joining outer and inner supplies the strongest bridge between personal affair and facial disclosure.
Dust and earth-color supply a deposited visible residue for the adverse outcome.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the direction by which the adverse layer covers the face.
Constriction and reduction give the darkened outcome a capacity-closing counterpart to the opened joyful surface.

structural_cues: 80:38-41 follows the focus without a new actor and shifts from each person's affair to contrasted faces.
The repeated يَوْمَئِذٍ ties the private affair and the public facial states to the same temporal frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposed faces and opposed surface processes; I infer that these are outputs of the individualized affair immediately before them. A live alternative is that both simply belong to the same event while the face states arise from a broader judgment, not directly from each شَأْنٌ.

changed_reading.before: The personal affair remains an invisible inner preoccupation.
changed_reading.after: The affair is a latent adjudicated state that reaches the surface: it opens and brightens some faces while closing others beneath accumulated, overpowering residue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the head-suture and tear-channel branch is anatomically remote from ordinary شَأْنٌ. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains a nearby bodily mechanism from the following faces and overpowering cover. Downstream prose should present it only as an activated somatic image of inward pressure becoming facially visible, never as the lexical replacement for 'affair.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to شَأْنٌ through its packet-listed cranial and tear-channel branch, while يُغْنِيهِ supplies the pressure's capacity-filling effect.

activation_trace.role: The head-suture and tear-channel branch supplies an internal anatomical route through which a personal state can gather and descend toward the eyes.
Sufficing and filling available function let the internal state occupy the person's expressive capacity.
The face-and-front branch supplies the anatomical exterior reached by the internal channel image.
Overtaking pressure supplies the adverse motion by which an inner state comes to dominate the visible face.

changed_reading.before: Each person has an abstract concern.
changed_reading.after: Each person carries an inward, channel-like pressure whose fullness reaches the eyes and face, opening some expressions and overpowering others.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The face-as-record synthesis is cross-domain and therefore should not be flattened into a literal claim that a face is a written page. It remains valid as an activation because the packet repeats س ف ر across scribal and facial settings, with branches of writing-disclosure and uncovering, while the focus provides an individual case that can stand for its bearer. Render it as a readable-surface analogy with the documentary and facial readings still independently live.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular personal شَأْنٌ and the standing-in force of يُغْنِيهِ anchor a case that can represent its bearer when disclosed.

activation_trace.role: The weighty-case branch supplies the individualized content that may become readable.
The standing-in branch allows the disclosed case or surface to represent the person without external testimony.
The written-sheet branch supplies the first readable surface in the cross-sequence analogy.
Writing that reveals its content supplies the documentary half of the repeated-root bridge.
Uncovering and removing a veil supplies the facial half of the bridge and turns appearance into disclosure.
The face-and-front branch provides the public surface on which the personal case can analogically be read.

changed_reading.before: Each person's affair is private, and the following face is merely an emotional reaction.
changed_reading.after: Each personal case stands for its bearer and is uncovered on the face like content disclosed from a sheet: the face becomes an analogically readable record.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because the smiling-or-lightning branch belongs to the focus root ك ل ل but is not the ordinary sense of كُلِّ. It remains worth carrying because the immediate sequel supplies visible gleam and opened surfaces, producing a precise root-level echo. Downstream prose must call it a latent flash or phonetic-root resonance and must never translate كُلِّ as smiling or lightning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier stays attached to the root of كُلِّ and treats its flashing-open branch as a secondary resonance beneath the required distributive sense.

activation_trace.role: The smiling-or-lightning-open branch plants a latent flash inside the word that distributes the scene person by person.
The personal state gives each latent flash a distinct interior cause rather than leaving it as free decoration.
Visible gleam likened to laughter externalizes the focus root's remote flashing resonance.
The appearing skin or surface branch gives the flash a stable visible plane.

changed_reading.before: كُلِّ only counts every person before the verse moves on to faces.
changed_reading.after: While still distributing every person, كُلِّ carries a faint flashing-open echo that the next bright and laughing faces realize, leaving the covered faces as its withheld counterpart.

strongest_changes: The recurrence of غ ن ي reverses apparent self-sufficiency from an attention-winning social posture into universal isolation and attention capture.
The measured-life and uncompleted-command sequence changes شَأْنٌ into a personal unfinished commission that no one else can discharge.
The kinship list turns sufficiency into exhausted relational capacity: a person's own case displaces even tether, origin, nurture, companionship, and descent.
The post-focus faces make the private affair a latent condition that becomes publicly legible as opening brightness or overpowering constriction.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one gloss: private exhaustive case, forced independence, spatial enclosure, attention reversal, disclosed record, unfinished assignment, embodied received provision, kinship collapse, and facial manifestation. Remote food/esophagus, tear-channel, and flashing branches remained live with explicit containment because context gave each a coherent activation path.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether يُغْنِيهِ should be weighted primarily toward availing, engrossing, forced self-sufficiency, or a secondary spatial staying resonance.
Whether the documentary apparatus makes the affair an actual individualized record or only offers an analogy for disclosure.
Whether the affair is the unfinished commission itself or the consequence and accounting of its noncompletion.
Whether the following facial states are direct outputs of each affair or parallel outcomes of the larger event.
How much semantic weight the food/esophagus, tear-channel, and flashing branches can bear beyond exploratory root-level resonance.
